diagnosis: Customer account is in ap-south, where private networking is not yet available per kb-0008. Additionally, the business plan tier does not include the private networking entitlement (kb-0010). Requests in unsupported regions remain queued rather than failing, which matches the reported behavior.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. Private networking is currently available only in us-east, us-west and eu-west, and is not yet offered in ap-south. In unsupported regions, enablement requests remain queued rather than returning an error, which is why nothing appeared to happen. Please also note that private networking is a premium-tier feature, so access would additionally require the appropriate plan entitlement. We don't have an availability date to share for ap-south at this time, but your interest in the region has been noted.
